test_integer_dtypes: test that Boost.Python correctly converts numpy int8, int16, int32, int64 signed and unsigned integer dtypes
test_float_dtypes: test that Boost.Python correctly converts numpy float32, float64, complex64, complex128 floating point dtypes
test_named_integer_dtypes: test that Boost.Python correctly converts numpy bool_, byte, ubyte, short, ushort, intc, uintc named integer dtypes
review_dtype_equivalent: review the dtype_ext.equivalent function that compares two numpy dtype objects for equivalence
test_longdouble_dtypes: test that Boost.Python correctly converts numpy longdouble and clongdouble types when available on the platform
